title: Claims Manual: Valuables Floater Loss Settlement
content:
Claims manual, Larkspur Valuables Floater: settling a covered loss. The settlement basis, the deductible and the fine art percentage applied to a claim are those of the floater's own tier.

## Settlement clauses

**S1. Basis.** Under the least of repair, replacement or scheduled value basis, the carrier pays the least of the repair cost, the cost to replace with a like item, and the scheduled value. Under the agreed value basis, a total loss pays the scheduled value. Fine art may pay up to the tier's fine art percentage of its scheduled value on proof of a higher market value.

**S2. Deductible.** A deductible applies per occurrence where the tier has one.

**S3. Fine art breakage.** Breakage of fine art is paid only where the tier covers fine art breakage.

**S4. Blanket items.** A blanket (unscheduled) item pays up to the tier's most-paid figure for one unscheduled item.

**S5. Pairs and sets.** Under the pair and set clause the loss of one item of a pair or set pays the loss in value of the set, never its full value when the rest remains.

**S6. Total loss and the schedule.** A replacement or cash payment for a total loss removes the item from the schedule, with the reason total loss paid.

**S7. Voids.** A payment that has already been voided is never voided again.

Claim money is issued per claim and per item, as a repair, replacement, cash or pair and set payment; a voided payment reduces the money issued on the claim.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

| Case | Reasoning | Paid (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Select, ring scheduled at 4000 USD, repair 900 USD, like replacement 3500 USD | least of 900, 3500 and 4000 is 900; Select deductible of 100 USD once for the occurrence | 800 |
| Valuables Floater Collector (agreed value), bracelet scheduled at 15000 USD, total loss | scheduled value | 15000 |
| Valuables Floater Collector, painting scheduled at 20000 USD, market value proven at 34000 USD | up to 150 percent of 20000 | at most 30000 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred, pair of earrings scheduled at 6000 USD, one lost, remaining earring worth 2000 USD alone | the loss is the set's loss in value, 6000 less 2000; never the full 6000 | 4000 (the set's loss in value) |
| Valuables Floater Preferred, unscheduled pendant under the blanket, loss 1600 USD | up to 1000 USD for one unscheduled item | 1000 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred, scheduled vase (fine art) broken | Preferred does not cover fine art breakage | nothing |
| Valuables Floater Prestige, the same breakage | Prestige covers fine art breakage | paid on the tier's basis |

## Points of judgement

- **Total loss paid by replacement or cash.** The item leaves the schedule; a repair or pair and set payment does not remove it.
- **Voiding.** A void is recorded against one payment; a second void of the same payment is not recorded.
